# NeuralNexus repo secrets
#
# Create each of these in:
#   GitHub > neuralnexus > Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions
#
#   Action  : Repository secrets  (private repo — "Actions" tab)
#   Type    : Secrets
#
# Copy each NAME (column 1) and paste in a value.
# All five are optional at build time (stubs are baked in), but each
# is required for its corresponding feature at runtime.

# -- required for Prisma migrations + DB access ----------------
# Connection string for the production Postgres instance this
# container should point at. Use postgres://user:***@host:port/db
#   DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nn:***@localhost:5432/neuralnexus
#
#   (Only needed if you run `npx prisma migrate deploy` inside the
#    container before `next start`. Optional: not consumed by Next.)
#
#   Shadow DB — Prisma 4 `migrate deploy` uses this to verify
#   migration checksums. Usually a second Postgres instance or a
#   throwaway schema. Same format as DATABASE_URL.
#   SHADOW_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nn:***@localhost:5432/nn_shadow

# -- required for NextAuth sign-in -----------------------------
# Must be the same as every session cookie issued by the server
# (otherwise existing sessions are invalid on the next deploy).
#   NEXTAUTH_SECRET

# GitHub OAuth App credentials. Create one at
# github.com/settings/developers > New OAuth App, then paste in
#   GITHUB_ID          (Client ID)
#   GITHUB_SECRET      (Client secret)
